breadcrumb() displays a semantic trail where preceding items link cleanly and the final item marks the current page. { "type": "breadcrumb", "items": [ {"label": "Workspace", "href": "#"}, {"label": "Agents", "href": "#"}, {"label": "Researcher v2"} ] }
Parameter Type Description items list[dict] Ordered crumb dicts with label and optional href or page (SPA route ID).
